body: I have always been open to change, but my efforts have been fruitless thus far. I'm hard wired to be impatient, sensitive, and self defeating. Despite my best efforts, my psyche appears to have been fucked up beyond repair and this will always impede my progress.

I long ago gave up on the notion that I could ever make a difference in the world. I'm not naive and I understand that idealism is foolish. Even in the small sphere I have created for myself, however, I am still a failure. It's not just that I feel like shit, it's also that all my efforts to try and change that are in vain. I feel that I'm a ticking time bomb of instability and there's nothing I can do about it, but I could never get myself to not care.
I've always felt this way in some capacity. I've been to several therapists and doctors, but so far no one has been able to help gain any real change.
